name: commitments-progress
title: Commitments progress
description: Public goals with their progress: target, current value, deadline and last-updated date, in rows a reader can check.
docs: Pass title, description, groups (a heading and its commitments; each commitment has an id, a title, the current and target values with an optional unit, a deadline written as 2028, 2028-06 or 2028-12-31, a status of done, on-track, at-risk or missed, and an optional note), updatedAt (required) and reportHref. Each row shows its progress as a labelled progressbar whose value text is the same figures written out (62% of 100%, or 4 of 6 warehouses when the unit is a word), the deadline in a time element and the status as a chip with a word and an icon, so nothing depends on colour: weight does the telling, with at risk the solid chip and missed the destructive one (its text is darkened in the light theme to keep AA contrast). A tally under the heading counts the commitments in each state. The date of the last update is always shown, and once it is older than staleAfterDays (180 by default), measured against the now you pass or the current time, the section says so in words. The current time is the moment the section renders, so a page that is generated once shows the note only as of its build: revalidate it on a schedule, or pass a now that you keep fresh. Rows stack on a phone and sit in three columns from 768px of width. State each goal as a number that grows towards its target, such as a cut achieved. labels translates the fixed words, and locale and timeZone format the numbers and dates.
